findings.title: Saved-state claims exceed the evidence
findings.text: 2 runs claim a saved assessment after failed saves, without a successful commit. Some claims follow scripted fallback replies; they remain false at the time they are delivered.

findings.title: Assessment records lose evidence distinctions
findings.text: 6 runs persist incorrect assistance flags or answer-source links. Correct answer text alone does not establish an accurate trainee assessment.

findings.title: Receipt format affects the headline score
findings.text: 5 runs fail only because a truthful confirmation omits the literal receipt ID. Accepting those confirmations changes strict completion from 10/42 to 15/42. This is a scoring sensitivity, not a harness improvement.
